summary.text: David Friess has represented the 115th District in the Illinois House since January 2021.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, he was born and raised in Southern Illinois, graduated from Chester High School, and enlisted in the Air Force, later joining the reserves and participating in Desert Storm.
He earned a B.S. in Criminal Justice from Mercer University and a Juris Doctorate from John Marshall Law School.
